'''Eward Aybara''' was [[Perrin]]'s uncle and brother of [[Con Aybara]]. He was married to [[Magde]].

== Appearance ==
He was stout and looked very similar to his wife.

==Activities==
He lived on the Aybara farm with the rest of Perrin's family. [[Padan Fain]] murders Perrin's entire family including Eward. Their deaths are blamed on Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|29}}
